set.title: Workplace policies starter set
set.description: Three documents written by Resgrid for businesses and other employers: the employee handbook acknowledgment, workplace safety rules, and reporting an injury or a near miss. Employees read and acknowledge them; insert your own policy text and the rules that apply where you operate.

protocols.name: Employee handbook acknowledgment
protocols.description: Each employee confirms they have read the handbook and know where to find it.

blocks.html: [Insert your employee handbook, or link to it as an attachment.]

blocks.title: By acknowledging, you confirm that you

items.html: Have read the handbook and know where to find it.
Know who to ask when something in it is not clear.
Will read and acknowledge it again when it changes.

protocols.name: Workplace safety rules
protocols.description: The safety rules everyone on site follows.

items.html: Wears the protective equipment their task and area require.
Uses only the equipment they have been trained and authorized to use.
Keeps exits, walkways and fire equipment clear.
Stops work and reports a hazard they cannot make safe themselves.
Knows the evacuation signal, the exits and the assembly point.

blocks.html: [Insert your site's own rules and the occupational safety rules that apply where you operate.]

protocols.name: Reporting an injury or near miss
protocols.description: What to do after an injury, an illness at work or a near miss.

items.html: Get first aid or call the emergency services.
Make the area safe so that no one else is hurt.
Tell your supervisor before the end of the shift.
Complete the incident report: what happened, where, when, who was involved and who saw it.
Report near misses too: they show where the next injury could happen.

blocks.title: Reporting to the authorities
blocks.html: Some injuries must be reported to a regulator within a set time. [Insert the reporting rules that apply where you operate and who files the report.]
